_note: Ather Energy has one reportable segment (electric two-wheelers and related products and services). The useful build is volume (wholesale dispatches) x revenue per unit; revenue splits into vehicles (~86-87%) and non-vehicle (AtherStack Pro software, accessories, service, charging; 13-14%). Revenue and EBITDA are Screener (FY26 consolidated, earlier standalone; Rs crore); EBITDA is Screener's basis (before other income), which differs from the company's definition (after other income). Q3FY26 revenue/EBITDA derived as FY26 less the other three quarters (Screener omits the quarter). AGM = company's adjusted gross margin on total income. Market share = company (Vahan + Telangana portal).
